label: In code, the token 'test'/'Test' when it begins the name of a function or method being declared (Python def test_..., Java/C# void testX or TestX, Go func TestX), strongest in Python; xUnit framework names (assertEqual and other self.assertX methods, assertEquals, TestCase, setUp) fire more weakly. Quiet: 'test' in prose, 'test' glued after another word or a dot (run_test, self.test_x), calls such as test(...) or JS test('...')/it('...'), the bare assert keyword and mock assert_called methods.
